$ rea completions zsh
exit: 0
--- stdout
#compdef rea
_incur_complete_rea() {
    local completions=("${(@f)$(
        export _COMPLETE_INDEX=$(( CURRENT - 1 ))
        export COMPLETE="zsh"
        "rea" -- "${words[@]}" 2>/dev/null
    )}")
    if [[ -n $completions ]]; then
        _describe 'values' completions -S ''
    fi
}
compdef _incur_complete_rea rea
<end>
--- stderr
<end>
